title: How Kodak Exposed Nuclear Testing
summary: Veritasium tells how Kodak film was fogged by radioactive fallout from the first atomic tests, letting the company detect nuclear testing before anyone announced it. The video also covers the deal to keep it quiet and how fallout contaminated packaging.
why: HN commenters bring it up as a good related watch in any thread about fallout, nuclear tests or detecting hidden events through indirect evidence.

quote.text: Veritasium did an eye opening vid on how fallout blew across the country and was ruining Kodak's film on the East Coast.
